source_policy_decisions.decision: Require a constituent-to-whole relation before tayap. Do not admit mere unrelated counting.
Treat ayac after dvi/tri as an optional replacement of an already admitted tayap. Preserve feminine and pronominal consequences through the replacement history.
Admit the commentary's two analyses of ubha's numerical status, but in both make ayac obligatory and retain its distinct accent. Exclude only a retained ubhataya branch under this rule.

Apply the surplus suffix only when excess and target share a denomination and the target is hundred, thousand or their stated combination. Mixed units and other totals remain outside this construction, not outside the language.

blocked_or_open: ubhataya is blocked by the obligatory replacement in 5.2.44.
Five over a hundred, bare ten over a hundred, eleven over thirty and mixed maasha/karshapana input fail different guards of 5.2.45.
Complete paradigms, wider accent evidence and the historical priority of the two ubha analyses remain Open.
